name: Pelica
long_description: Pelica helps risk-bearing healthcare organizations improve quality performance, close care gaps, and lower administrative cost using specialized AI agents. Built for health plans, IPAs, MSOs, ACOs, and risk-bearing medical groups, Pelica unifies claims, EHR, pharmacy, lab, and ADT data into one live member record, then gives quality, risk adjustment, pharmacy, provider network, and care management teams agents that carry work through to completion. Pelica currently serves more than 350,000 members.
one_liner: AI agents for risk-bearing healthcare organizations
